verdict.rationale: GitHub's Copilot suite (agent mode, autofix, code review, dependency fix suggestions) clearly provides AI-generated insights/suggestions from code data, as shown in multiple docs (github-docs-1,2,5,6,9). However, community evidence is mixed—early Copilot users found it useful but only ~10% accurate, and raised concerns about licensing and malicious code suggestions, indicating real but imperfect delivery.
